Summary: inbound ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging for Zendesk and Freshdesk. Primary ask is fast, concise summaries for agent view and automatic taxonomy tagging to drive macros and routing. Key constraints: maintain <300ms median inference for summary insert into ticket UI, support bursty spikes (target 500-700 rps during promo spikes), near-zero false tagging on high priority queues.

Technical requirements / notes:
- Primary workload: ticket summarization (short concise TL;DR + key metadata), automated tag assignment (multi-label), email thread condensation, suggested macros and recommended reply snippets.
- Integration: Zendesk app + Freshdesk webhook support. Prefer server-to-server API (VPC option) for PII-sensitive queues.
- Performance: target p95 latency for summary API <500ms, typical median <300ms; sustain 500 rps steady, 700 rps bursts for up to 10 minutes.
- Quality guardrails: tag confidence threshold configurable; fallback to human review for priority/high-risk tickets.
- Tool-calling: needs ability to call internal ticketing API to add tags/trigger macros; RBAC and audit trail required.
- Data handling: retention 90 days for POC logs, option to disable retention in production; must support KMS-encrypted storage and SOC2 controls.
- Model preference: open to quantized Llama-family or Redwood-curated 7B/13B variants; want to evaluate cost vs inference latency.
